timing: Defined after live survival counts were visible, before full native velocity/phase results; supplementary diagnosis only
scope: All four arms and all 96 conditions per arm; raw request reconstructed from the frozen deterministic profile before RMCS heading/lateral projection
supplementary_stop_window: For translational start-stop only: max(1s, abs(request)/(mean(wheel_mu,ground_mu)*9.81)+0.5s) after phase start
physical_model_limits: Quasi-static traction estimate, not a safety bound or a new passing threshold
